Support
Coloring · Collections · Focus timer

Your photos, ready to color

Arista turns a photo into a coloring page, gives you brushes, pencils and fills to color it on your iPhone, and keeps the finished art close, on collection boards and behind a calm focus timer.

Coming soon

Coming to the App Store as Arista Studio. iPhone, in English and Vietnamese.

What's inside

📷

Photo to page

Take or pick a photo and get a page with clean outlines. The Original style is traced on your iPhone, free and offline; AI styles are drawn by an AI model.

🖍️

Color it your way

Fill, brushes, pencil and pen, palettes and layers of undo. Your artworks and collections stay on your phone.

🌿

Collections

Cut out what you colored and arrange it on boards with stickers and notes.

⏳

Focus with it

A focus timer with your artwork, a soft gradient or your own video behind the clock, floating particles and ambient sounds.

Free to color, credits for the AI

Tracing pages on your phone, coloring, collections and the focus timer are free. AI pages use credits: 10 credits for an AI page. Every App Store account gets 30 credits once, to try it.

MAX

Prices shown are US prices; the App Store shows yours in your currency. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Unused credits roll over while the plan is active, up to three months' worth.

Privacy policy

Your photos stay on your phone unless you use an AI style, and then only after you allow it. No ads, no trackers.
